full_page.content:
1934, September
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 222 Cont.
Sep. 5 Patrick Leary - 72 - (Lyons, 0.) cancer on mouth.
Lewis Rowland - 55 - non Cath. - head-aches 20 yrs. - raised family all Cath's - They ask pp.
Mrs. Phyllis Spencer - 27 - head aches etc for ten yrs. - daughter of above L.R.
Page 223 Page 224
Blank Page
Sep. Edw'd Thomas - 20 - Richmond, Virg'a - studying. .. nervous break down Clarence Peter - 35 - cronic sinus - 18 yrs - 6 operations !!! liver - had more than 3rd of scalp removed scraped and replaced.
Julia May Laurina - 20 - T.B. . Mother widow
Mrs. Johannah Deimel - Abcess. Marie Mahony - 49 - diabetis Wm. Joseph Mahony - 16 - Vocation Blank Page
Page 225 Page 226 Sep. 12 Francis Daly - 24 - Enrolled a week Today for cancerous tuomers of the lungs given up by doctors as hopeless .... Now reported recover- ing ... Has made remarkable impression on associates - some of them patients - wife a convert .... needed faith. . has started.
Rachael Smith - 57 - gall stones Wilfred Oliver - 7 - deaf since 3 - then just learning to talk. .. Miss McIlhargey - about 35 - groth on instep of foot.
Edw'd - 19 - graduate of St. Anthony's - had been promised tuition in U.D .. ... Things looked more than doubtful was enrolled Thursday last ..... Friday his uncle came across and saved the day.
Blank Page
Page 227 Page 228 Sep. Frank Dailey - 24 - Hodgkins Sickness in Eloise Hopeless - Wife con- vert - Enrolled at 10 p.m. (1.00) promising perpetual enrollment & --- Communion.
